packages.name: @kiln/lab
packages.purpose: Perf Lab's lab.js language, headless: builders, the six build passes, queries, derives, estimators and hypothesis verdicts on @kiln/evidence, a synthetic data layer and an injected LabData for real runs.
packages.notes: exports '.', './node' (readPerfLabStore, readPresets) and './presets/*'; only dependency @kiln/evidence; only consumer apps/workbench. Scripts check-pl.ts, extract-fixtures.ts, perf-lab.ts (178 LOC).

packages.name: lab-workbench
packages.purpose: Perf Lab's browser workbench and its lab.js language: a verbatim copy of Playback ML-PERF-001 experiments/lab-workbench at Playback commit cdb84891c, its own pnpm root.
packages.notes: src/ (290 files) holds lang, data, presets, Redux features, React components (atomic design); the 5682-line quality-golden.json fixture is excluded from loc_prod. pnpm-workspace.yaml declares packages: [].

packages.name: lab-workbench/server
packages.purpose: Perf Lab server: Hono API under /api, node:sqlite store, one-job-at-a-time runner that spawns the Python workloads, importers for repetition outputs and PR 1005 qualification reports, evidence archives, COCO datasets and media, and the LLM assistant.
packages.notes: Binds 127.0.0.1 with no authentication (server/config.ts:28). Imports browser modules from ../src/lang (util, values, rows, detections) and a UI file (IdePane/reference.ts).

packages.name: lab-workbench/workloads
packages.purpose: The real workloads the Perf Lab runner executes: deformable-attention sampling (unfused, gather, compiled with TorchInductor), the Grounding DINO paired runner from PR 1005, and a capability probe.
packages.notes: uv project perf-lab-local (package = false), torch 2.14.1, transformers 5.2.0; workloads/.venv/ is on disk and gitignored.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: build a lab.js program
functionalities.description: Evaluate a lab.js program and run the six passes (structure, expand-resolve, trace, validate, lower, plan) into an IR, lints and a capture plan.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: queries and derives over runs
functionalities.description: Lazy q.* queries materialised into Rows, grouped and aggregated in derives, memoised by the parameters they read.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: provenance-tracked values
functionalities.description: Every number carries a unit and provenance (observed, derived, heuristic, illustrative, unknown); missing is never zero; observed rows are sealed.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: paired comparison statistics
functionalities.description: pairedRatio bootstrap over per-process medians with an interleaved paired run order; offered-rate accounting for open-loop load.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: hypothesis verdicts
functionalities.description: Evaluate a hypothesis predicate over derive rows into supported, refuted, open or unqualified (package adds undecided).

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: detection quality comparison
functionalities.description: Pair detections between arms within tolerance and evaluate against COCO ground truth (port of PR 1005 grounding_dino_quality.py).

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: synthetic data
functionalities.description: Deterministic synthetic runs per capture hash and rep, so every program renders before anything is measured.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: parameters and URL state
functionalities.description: Typed parameters with binding phases (plan, data, view); plan-bound changes rebuild and change capture hashes; values round-trip through the URL.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: board views
functionalities.description: Boards of table, chart, timeline, stat, manifest, mirror, kernel card, ledger, stepper, route, hypothesis card, text, gallery and detections views over derive rows.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: plan and run jobs
functionalities.description: Propose a job from the plan, approve it, run captures one process at a time with paired arm order, import each repetition, report progress over SSE.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: local workload execution
functionalities.description: Spawn uv run python -m perf_lab_local.run per capture and rep; JSON-line events on stdout; JSON records in the rep directory.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: Grounding DINO paired runs
functionalities.description: Run baseline and candidate DINO revisions in one process over dataset images and import the PR 1005 qualification reports.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: host capabilities
functionalities.description: Probe the local host (python, torch, devices, tools) and combine it with synthetic remote hosts to decide which captures can run.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: evidence archive import
functionalities.description: Upload a tar.gz of qualification reports, validate every entry, register datasets it contains, and import its captures without running them.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: COCO datasets and media
functionalities.description: Register COCO selections, materialise public images with SHA-256 checks, serve public media, browse images with predicted and ground-truth boxes.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: lab assistant
functionalities.description: LLM assistant that writes lab.js code against the open board; the browser runs the code and returns observations; at most four executions per question; transcripts archived.

functionalities.name: Perf Lab: preset programs
functionalities.description: Example lab.js programs from hello to the PR 1005 DINO comparison, with scripted assistant replies for scenarios A and C.

functionalities.name: @kiln/lab: headless build for Kiln
functionalities.description: Build a lab program in Node or the Kiln workbench against injected LabData (catalog, bundles, datasets) and Kiln host reports, or against synthetic data.

functionalities.name: @kiln/lab: read a Perf Lab store
functionalities.description: Open a copy of a Perf Lab SQLite store read-only to replay or check builds against measured data.

service_calls.description: REST /api: programs, catalog, seed, bundles, jobs, annotations, evidence, datasets, media, hosts
GET /api/events: job progress and catalog changes
POST /api/assistant/turns: assistant replies; results posted back to /api/assistant/messages/:id/result
uv run python -m perf_lab_local.run --spec --rep --out, one process per capture and rep; JSON-line events on stdout
uv run python -m perf_lab_dino.run with both arm specs per rep
perf_lab_local.probe for local capabilities (180 s timeout)
rep directory records (manifest, activation, quality, timing, cpu, trace, memory JSON) read by importRepetition
dataset materialisation downloads public COCO images and verifies SHA-256
readPerfLabStore opens a temp copy of the Perf Lab store (db + wal) read-only
@kiln/lab LabData filled from /api/lab/* (programs, catalog, bundles, datasets, media) by the workbench's lab api.js
lab:import copies a Perf Lab .data directory (store copy opened read-only, archives, media) into the Kiln database, checking every hash

reusable_components.name: lab.js language and compiler
reusable_components.description: Builders, six-pass build to an IR and capture plan, runtime for derives and signals.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Already packaged as @kiln/lab; the open step is making lab-workbench consume it instead of src/lang (9 of 16 files differ only mechanically).

reusable_components.name: rows and query algebra with provenance
reusable_components.description: Rows (filter, group, aggregate, follow links) over entity graphs, lazy q.* queries, provenance-carrying values.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: No lab-specific dependency beyond entity kinds; could live beside @kiln/evidence as a query package [inferred].

reusable_components.name: detection pairing and ground-truth evaluation
reusable_components.description: Pure TS port of PR 1005 detection comparison: maximum matching within tolerances, IoU with crowd rules, verdicts.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Self-contained and golden-tested; three implementations exist (Python, two TS).

reusable_components.name: paired-ratio bootstrap and offered-rate accounting
reusable_components.description: Process-level paired ratio with bootstrap CI and open-loop offered-rate accounting.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: The package version already delegates to @kiln/evidence; Perf Lab keeps an older copy that ignores the seed option.

reusable_components.name: capture spec hash (cyrb53 + stableStringify)
reusable_components.description: The identity of every Perf Lab capture: cyrb53 over the key-sorted lowered spec.
reusable_components.current_consumers: @kiln/exec perf-lab-sampler kind; apps/server lab importer; separately copied in @kiln/lab and lab-workbench
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Keep one implementation (labCaptureHash) and import it from @kiln/lab and Perf Lab; the copies must stay bit-identical or stored artifacts become unmatchable.

reusable_components.name: safe tar.gz reader
reusable_components.description: In-memory ustar/pax/GNU reader that refuses links, devices and paths escaping the archive root.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Two diverging copies; a small Node package would serve both servers.

reusable_components.name: workload process protocol
reusable_components.description: Spec file in, JSON-line events on stdout, JSON records in a rep directory, exit code as validity, stderr tail for errors.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Implicit in run.py and runner.ts with no schema file; Kiln has its own @kiln/exec kinds for the same job.

reusable_components.name: qualification-report importer
reusable_components.description: Importer for PR 1005 'detection-qualification/v1' report trees into entities and links.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Depends on the browser val(), which @kiln/lab removed; port needs an observed-value constructor owned by importers.

reusable_components.name: LabData injection seam
reusable_components.description: The interface through which a build reads catalog, bundles and datasets, replacing module-global fetch caches.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: The pattern to copy back into Perf Lab to remove module state from src/data.

reusable_components.name: lab board view set
reusable_components.description: 18 views keyed by view kind over derive rows and IR view nodes.
reusable_components.packaging_notes: Two UI stacks with no shared code; a written view contract (kind, inputs, props) would let one stack go.

duplications.title: lab language compiler: lab-workbench/src/lang vs packages/lab/src/lang
duplications.description: Two copies of the lab.js language. Of 16 language files, 9 differ only mechanically (strict tsconfig: .ts imports, | undefined, !, constructor fields), 3 by one-line semantic edits (build lowered normal form, runtime sealed rows, library below/above), 4 are rewritten on @kiln/evidence (rows, values, stats, util). Raw/normalised diff counts in notes section 9.5. History (area E): KILN-001 Phase 8a ported Perf Lab's language into @kiln/lab: three files rewritten on @kiln/evidence, 'everything else was edited in place', differing 'only mechanically'; check:pl proves equivalence against Perf Lab's own code.

locations.note: lowered normal form, the only semantic edit in build

duplications.suggested_consolidation: Make lab-workbench import @kiln/lab (or retire lab-workbench/src/lang); the mechanical differences are compatible with the looser Perf Lab tsconfig.

duplications.title: lab data layer: lab-workbench/src/data vs packages/lab/src/data
duplications.description: Synthetic generator and source are near-copies (generate norm 47 lines, source 14); env, bundles, capabilities and datasets were re-architected in the package around LabData injection, removing module-global caches and fetch.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Adopt the package data layer in Perf Lab with a LabData backed by its own /api.

duplications.title: capture hash: three cyrb53 + stableStringify implementations
duplications.description: The capture identity is implemented three times and must stay bit-identical for stored artifacts to match.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: One implementation (labCaptureHash) imported everywhere, with a golden-vector test.

duplications.title: hypothesis verdicts: lab-workbench HypothesisView vs @kiln/lab lang/hypothesis
duplications.description: Perf Lab computes verdicts inside HypothesisView; @kiln/lab has a headless hypothesis.ts on @kiln/evidence verdict with different semantics (undecided; a throwing predicate is open).
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Use the headless module in both UIs.

duplications.title: lab presets: lab-workbench/src/presets/programs vs packages/lab/presets
duplications.description: Nine programs and both reply scripts identical; local-sampler (15 lines: host parameter, workload path) and dino-pr1005 (4 lines) edited; sampler-hosts only in the package. The package comment still says copied unmodified.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Keep presets in the package only; host-specific edits become parameters.

duplications.title: Perf Lab server modules ported into apps/server/src/lab
duplications.description: tar, evidence, datasets and store exist in both servers as adapted ports (changed lines: tar 61, evidence 84, datasets 182, store 327). apps/server/src/lab/importer.ts is a different importer (whole .data directory), not a port.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Extract tar/evidence/media storage into a shared Node package, or retire the Perf Lab server.

duplications.title: Perf Lab store reader: copy-then-open implemented twice
duplications.description: Both copy the WAL-mode SQLite store (and -wal) into a temp directory before opening it read-only.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Six passes, plan-lambda resolution with a NeedsEvidence control-flow exception, parameter-binding inference by dry-run tracing, ~25 lint codes, lowering and plan staging in one module; copied as packages/lab/src/lang/build.ts.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Split per pass; keep one copy.

complexity_hotspots.reason: A Proxy records any unknown method as a prop; correctness depends on VIEW_METHODS/CAPTURE_METHODS being complete, and kinds missing from the table (detections, gallery) are never checked.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Make every view kind declare its methods.

complexity_hotspots.reason: AsyncFunction evaluation of model or scripted code with live lab/self handles, snapshots and rollback, two reply sources.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Separate the handle API from the execution loop.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Three execution paths (process per rep, DINO both arms per process, archive import) with their own validity and quality rules; paired ordering; cancellation.
Parses a whole report tree format (profiler tables, JUnit, paired timing, predictions, memory pools) into entities.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Document detection-qualification/v1 as a format with fixtures.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Synthetic generators for every workload and collector; labels generated numbers observed (fixed in the package).
buildLab builds twice around a seed POST and a bundle load, with host 'local' hard-coded.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Use LabData and host reports as in @kiln/lab.

complexity_hotspots.reason: SSE turns, browser round-trip of code results, step limits, archive/restore library, token accounting.

facts.subject: @kiln/lab
facts.fact: The only consumer of @kiln/lab is apps/workbench (package.json:21, src/ui/lab/api.js, state.js, panels.jsx, build.mjs, test/lab-e2e.mjs); apps/server does not depend on it.

facts.subject: @kiln/lab
facts.fact: Of 16 language files, 9 differ from lab-workbench only mechanically, 3 by one-line edits and 4 are rewritten on @kiln/evidence.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: A program is evaluated with new Function over the library free names in strict mode; there is no other sandbox.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: The build has six passes: structure, expand-resolve, trace, validate, lower, plan.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: A capture is identified by cyrb53(stableStringify(lowered spec)); the server recomputes it and answers 409 spec_hash_mismatch.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: quality_gate_sha256 and (without a dataset) fixture_manifest_sha256 hold cyrb53 values, not SHA-256; importers label the gate sha256:<cyrb53>.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: Parameter binding is the strongest reader phase, plan > data > view; plan-bound changes rebuild and change capture hashes.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: View kinds absent from VIEW_METHODS (detections, gallery) accept any method without an unknown-method lint.

facts.subject: lab.js
facts.fact: Compiling the hello preset yields 12 nodes, 13 edges, 2 timing captures x3 reps on playback@dgx and lints no-quality-gate, no-activation-rule, no-repetition.

facts.subject: stats.pairedRatio
facts.fact: Perf Lab resamples processes, not requests: median per (arm, rep), ratio per rep, median of ratios, 2000-iteration bootstrap.

facts.subject: stats.pairedRatio
facts.fact: Perf Lab accepts a seed option but seeds the bootstrap from the ratios ('pairedRatio:' + ratios); @kiln/lab honours the seed.

facts.subject: values
facts.fact: missing is not zero: its valueOf is NaN; observed rows are sealed and mutation throws ProvenanceError.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/src/data
facts.fact: Synthetic kernel metrics are created with val() and so labelled observed; @kiln/lab relabels them illustrative (P-7).

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: Every route is unauthenticated; the server binds 127.0.0.1.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: The runner executes one job and one process at a time and shuffles arms per rep with rng(paired_order_seed:rep).

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: Schema v3 re-keyed runs to (hash, rep) because ref-keyed runs overwrote each other across parameter values.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: A run is valid iff the process exited 0 and the declared activation held; quality is qualified iff a gate was declared, quality passed and the run is valid.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: Server modules import browser code: ../src/lang/util, values, rows, detections, and the UI file IdePane/reference.ts.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: The assistant never runs model code on the server; the browser runs it and posts the result to /api/assistant/messages/:id/result.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/server
facts.fact: qualification.ts imports the PR 1005 detection-qualification/v1 report format; it is not a statistics module.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/workloads
facts.fact: manifest.json records spec_sha256, a real SHA-256 of the sort_keys spec: a third spec identity, matching neither the cyrb53 capture hash nor quality_gate_sha256.

facts.subject: lab-workbench/workloads
facts.fact: workloads/.venv is on disk and gitignored; a naive find over workloads counts site-packages.

facts.subject: lab-workbench
facts.fact: Perf Lab language test src/lang/evidence.test.ts imports evaluateHypothesis from a React component.

facts.subject: lab-workbench
facts.fact: The jobList view is declared in the library and VIEW_METHODS but has no renderer in either UI.

facts.subject: apps/server/src/lab
facts.fact: apps/server/src/lab/importer.ts imports a whole Perf Lab .data directory into Kiln; it is not a port of Perf Lab importer.ts.

facts.subject: lab-workbench
facts.fact: The 18 board views are re-implemented, without shared code, in apps/workbench/src/ui/lab; area B records this as the duplication "lab board panels: lab-workbench views vs apps/workbench/src/ui/lab". Kiln has 21 view kinds (no metrics alias); an unknown kind renders a panel error in both.

facts.subject: apps/server/src/lab
facts.fact: Kiln serves Perf Lab data routes at /api/lab without job, host, archive, materialisation or assistant routes.

formats.name: perf-lab capture spec/1
formats.consumers: lab-workbench/server (job_captures, artifacts, spec.json for workloads); perf_lab_local/run.py; perf_lab_dino/run.py; @kiln/exec

fields.name: workload
fields.note: adapter, boundary, fixture_manifest_sha256 (cyrb53 unless dataset), dataset_sha256, image_ids, options

fields.name: comparison
fields.note: baseline_revision, candidate_revision, arm_revision, switches, corunner, paired_order_seed

fields.name: state, warmup, expect, phases, offer, admission, deadline

formats.notes: Identity = cyrb53(stableStringify(spec)); @kiln/lab ships it as lowered = JSON normal form.

formats.name: perf-lab workload event stream
formats.fields: One JSON object per stdout line (run.py:24-25 emit): start {mode, impl, device, requests}; warmup {i, ms}; request {i, ms}; done {window_ms}; error {message}. The runner logs each as job event script.<event>, keeps the last 8000 chars of stderr, and treats exit code 0 as success.
formats.notes: Implicit: no schema file; consumed in lab-workbench/server/runner.ts:46-100.

fields.name: manifest.json
fields.note: spec_sha256 (real SHA-256 of the sort_keys spec, not the cyrb53 capture hash), experiment, arm, mode, rep, impl, device, dtype, threads, shape, python/torch/numpy versions, platform, git_revision, workload_sha256, boundary, pid, started_at, inductor_cache (run.py:88-110)

fields.name: activation.json
fields.note: whether the requested implementation (e.g. compiled) was active

fields.name: quality.json
fields.note: maxAbsDiff vs eager unfused, tolerance, pass

fields.name: timing.json
fields.note: boundary, requests (per-request start/end/cpu ns), clock perf_counter_ns, cpu_clock thread_time_ns

formats.name: perf-lab run bundle
formats.consumers: GET /api/bundles; lab-workbench/src/data/bundles.ts; @kiln/lab reviveBundles; apps/server lab store

formats.name: lab IR/1
formats.consumers: lab-workbench Redux build slice and tabs; apps/workbench lab views

fields.name: boards, params, plan, experiments, hypotheses, stats, durationMs

formats.notes: Serialisable half of a build; functions live in BuildRegistry.

formats.name: detection-qualification/v1
formats.fields: Report tree under qualification/reports/: paired.json or example-predictions.json, artifact-provenance.json, run-configuration.json, profiler tables, JUnit XML.
formats.notes: History (area E): ML-PERF-002's archive format, used both for the imported PR 1005 dgx archive and for local runs. Layout prescribed by report layout prescribed by Playback services/detection/GPU.md; mode → report mapping in the ML-PERF-002 guide; defined in playback:ttmp/2026/10/12/ML-PERF-002--studying-grounding-dino-pr-1005-in-the-perf-lab-evidence-import-images-detections-and-datasets/design/01-intern-guide-studying-grounding-dino-acceleration-in-the-perf-lab.md:527-538.

formats.fields: JavaScript evaluated with the library free names (lab, rev, capture, q, stats, views, params...); one lab(...) value per program.

diagrams.title: Perf Lab: processes and data flow
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Browser["lab-workbench (Vite :5199)"]
    Prog["lab.js program"] --> Build["src/lang build (6 passes)"]
    Build --> IR["IR + plan"]
    IR --> Views["board views"]
    Data["src/data (synthetic + bundles)"] --> Build
    Agent["agent runtime"] --> Build
  end
  subgraph Server["lab-workbench/server (:5198, 127.0.0.1)"]
    API["Hono /api"] --> Store[("SQLite: perf-lab")]
    Runner["Runner (1 job, 1 process)"] --> Importer["importRepetition / importQualification"]
    Importer --> Store
    Assistant["PiAssistant"] --> LLM["LLM provider"]
  end
  subgraph Workloads["lab-workbench/workloads (uv)"]
    Local["perf_lab_local.run"]
    Dino["perf_lab_dino.run"]
  end
  Browser -- "REST /api, SSE /api/events" --> API
  Agent -- "SSE /api/assistant/turns" --> Assistant
  Runner -- "spawn: spec.json, rep" --> Local
  Runner -- "spawn: both arms" --> Dino
  Local -- "JSON lines + rep-N/*.json" --> Runner

diagrams.title: lab.js build pipeline
diagrams.source:
flowchart TD
  Src["program source"] --> Eval["evaluateProgram: new Function(lib names)"]
  Eval --> P1["1 structure: nodes, contains edges"]
  P1 --> P2["2 expand · resolve: arms x captures, plan lambdas (NeedsEvidence -> stage 2)"]
  P2 --> P3["3 trace: dry-run derives and live lambdas, param binding plan>data>view"]
  P3 --> P4["4 validate: lints"]
  P4 --> P5["5 lower: spec per capture, hash = cyrb53(stableStringify(spec))"]
  P5 --> P6["6 plan: stage 0 capabilities, 1 captures, 2 evidence; cached|import|execute|blocked"]
  P6 --> Out["IR (serialisable) + BuildRegistry (functions)"]

diagrams.title: Perf Lab job run sequence
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant UI as lab-workbench
  participant API as server /api
  participant R as Runner
  participant W as workload process
  UI->>API: POST /api/jobs (captures with hashes)
  API->>API: validateCaptures (recompute cyrb53, 409 on mismatch)
  UI->>API: POST /api/jobs/:id/approve
  API->>R: job approved
  loop each rep
    R->>R: shuffle arms with rng(paired_order_seed:rep)
    loop each arm in that order
      R->>W: uv run python -m perf_lab_local.run --spec --rep --out
      W-->>R: JSON-line events (start, warmup, request, done)
      W-->>R: exit code, rep-N/*.json
      R->>R: importRepetition -> runs, run_bundles
      R-->>UI: SSE job progress
    end
  end
  UI->>API: GET /api/bundles?hashes=...
